title: An action missing its required input is refused and saves nothing
statement: When the librarian leaves out any of the `required_input`, the library MUST refuse the action, say what is missing, and save nothing.
notes: A use case whose action needs no input marks `required_input` as `Not applicable:` with a reason; when every use case in a domain that follows the pattern does so, this rule does not apply in that domain.

title: A successful action saves the record and shows it as stored
statement: When the action succeeds, the library MUST save the `record` and show the `result` as now stored, so that the librarian can copy an ID onto a card or tag or tell the member the outcome.
notes: This rule names no setting: it is the point of the pattern, so it applies in every domain that follows it.

title: A saved tool reads the same in the catalog
statement: When the action saves a tool, the catalog MUST then list that tool exactly as the action showed it, so that the librarian sees one state of the tool wherever they look.
notes: The rule applies only where the action's `record` is a Tool: in a domain where every following use case saves something else, such as a member or a loan, it is waived.
